title: Resend has no verified people.frequencylocal.com domain, so conversational mail cannot send from its default address

source.ref: catch-up scan 2026-10-20; phase plan phase 3; PROG-EMAIL1

detail:
FILED 2026-10-20. THE CONSEQUENCE: DEFAULT_CONVERSATION_ADDRESS is people@people.frequencylocal.com (lib/comms/from-address.ts) and Resend has no verified people.frequencylocal.com domain, so a 1:1 conversation send from the house address is refused by the provider until the domain verifies. Owner action, no code: add the domain in Resend, copy the DNS records it shows into the frequencylocal.com zone (Vercel DNS), wait for Verified. Click-by-click steps are in the project thread.

CLOSED 2026-10-20. people.frequencylocal.com reads Verified in Resend (DKIM TXT and both SPF CNAMEs, added in GoDaddy). The owner ran the live pilot on the Daniel Tyack Space: a conversation message went out from the house address, arrived in the inbox, the reply came back into the thread, and a second Space's conversations did not show it (isolation check passed).

verify.evidence: PASS 2026-10-20: Resend lists people.frequencylocal.com as Verified; the owner's pilot send was accepted by the provider and delivered, the reply threaded back, and the second-Space isolation check passed.
